data.title: What brands ask us.
items: Can we see the guests partner hosts bring?
You see counts: bookings, attendance and repeat guests by partner. Names and contact details only come from people who opted in to hear from your brand.
Can we run events in several cities?
Yes. Each city’s events sit on your brand page, and the report rolls them up.
Can we keep a launch invite-only?
Yes. Invite-only events stay off public pages; only people with your link can book.
How do we find hosts to partner with?
Book a walkthrough and tell us the cities and formats you want. We’ll introduce hosts who fit.
No. Guests book and check in in their phone’s browser.
